title: What NOT To Do When a Police Officer Shows Up #2
description:
What was originally a domestic incident turns into a 26-year-old man getting arrested after hiding in a car trunk from the police. 

On October 9, 2020, dispatch received a call about a man causing a “physical” disturbance at a residence in Baraboo, WI. A resident of the home called the police on his stepson after an argument transpired. His stepson then slapped the phone out of his hand to prevent the 911 call. His mother decided to leave the residence with her son to avoid any further disputes. 

At the arrival of a convenience store, the stepson was aware of police en route and decided to hide in the trunk to avoid any police interaction. However, an officer already witnessed him crawling into the trunk of the vehicle.
